title: Natty Dominique and Johnny Dodds hiring him in the 1950s
summary: Dominique doubted him, then hired him; he recorded with them.

blocks.x: How did you make out in the 50s with Natty Dominic and Baby and those guys?

I did all right. Dominic was another guy. He couldn't see me to begin with. I don't blame the guys. He told, I understand a little Creole or a little French. My people spoke it very well, but I never did pay much attention to it. But I understood what he was saying. He told Al and Omar Simien, what you got this guy for? He can't play. That's what he told him, see. Just like Johnny Dots. But he had to eat it up too. Because I just kept on trying. And after a while I began to bloom out. And then he began to hire me and Johnny Dots hire me. I recorded with him. I did all right.
